data.narrative: Built a fail-fast environment configuration system where the same Docker image runs identically everywhere, controlled exclusively by environment variables with strict startup validation. Chose platform env vars (A) over a secret manager and env-overrides (A) over per-env files, then discovered and fixed a production-breaking bug where the deploy image silently baked in development .env defaults.

dimension_scores.observation: Ensured the production Docker image contains zero environment-specific values - eliminated baked-in .env files, git metadata, virtualenvs, and logs from the build output via hardened dockerignore patterns.
dimension_scores.evidence: docker run --rm linkops-compose-check ls -la /app shows only app/, migrations/, scripts/, requirements.txt - no .env files after adding **/.env, **/.env.*, **/.git, **/.venv exclusions.

dimension_scores.observation: Hardened the deployment path so the same image builds cleanly regardless of which context (compose vs prod Dockerfile) invokes it.
dimension_scores.evidence: Pointed docker-compose api build to context ../api with its own Dockerfile; verified compose up -d api yields a healthy container serving /live and /ready 200.

dimension_scores.observation: Added a startup log announcing the active environment, port, and log level while explicitly omitting database_url, jwt_secret, and all sensitive values.
dimension_scores.evidence: Startup log: {'environment': 'development', 'port': '8000', 'log_level': 'info', 'msg': 'Service starting'}; grepped all logs for postgresql://, JWT_SECRET, and the real secret - zero matches.

dimension_scores.observation: Predicted the exact failure class the module targets - a production server silently running in development mode because a .env with localhost defaults was baked into the image - and root-caused it via the hint.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed root .dockerignore .env pattern only matching root-level files, allowing api/.env (APP_ENV=development, DATABASE_URL=...localhost...) into the prod image; verified by running the compose-built image without -e flags.

dimension_scores.observation: Ensured every required config value has no default so a missing variable produces a loud, immediate, named startup crash rather than a delayed runtime failure.
dimension_scores.evidence: Removing DATABASE_URL from .env produces 'database_url: Field required [type=missing]' with nonzero exit; APP_ENV=banana produces 'Input should be development, staging or production'.

dimension_scores.observation: Rewrote .env.example as the complete config contract documenting every variable with REQUIRED/OPTIONAL status, purpose, example, and safe default.
dimension_scores.evidence: .env.example now documents APP_ENV, PORT, DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET, CORS_ORIGIN, LOG_LEVEL, and tuning knobs with usage comments.

strengths: Mastery of fail-fast config validation - required fields with no defaults and named crash messages.
Sharp root-cause diagnosis of the baked-.env production bug including loading-order priority reasoning.
Correctly chose env-overrides and platform env vars for this service's size and documented the tradeoff.
data.recommendation: Carry the same fail-fast discipline into Module 04 observability: decide what each log line, metric, and alert will answer before adding it.

public_evidence.student_action: Implemented a pydantic-settings config module with a required Environment enum, no-default required fields for app_env/port/database_url/redis_url/jwt_secret/cors_origin, and validators for port, jwt_secret length, cors_origin scheme, and jwt_ttl.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Fail-fast startup validation in app/config.py with Settings() instantiated at import time.
public_evidence.proof: Removing DATABASE_URL or setting APP_ENV=banana crashes at import with a named ValidationError (verified locally and in-container).
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves the service cannot boot into a silently misconfigured production state - a hiring-bar skill.

public_evidence.student_action: Wired environment-aware behavior: CORS from settings.cors_origin, generic 500 responses in production with details only in development/staging, and an environment-announcing startup log that excludes secrets.
public_evidence.technical_detail: CORSMiddleware, env-gated exception handler, structured startup log in app/main.py.
public_evidence.proof: GET /live=200 and /ready=200 on compose container; startup log shows environment=development with zero secret leakage.
public_evidence.ability: Environment-aware application behavior and secret-safe logging.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows a production-safety mindset where configuration errors are treated as security vulnerabilities.

public_evidence.student_action: Diagnosed and fixed the deployed image baking development .env files (localhost defaults, APP_ENV=development) into production; hardened dockerignore patterns and corrected the compose build context.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Root .dockerignore now excludes **/.env, **/.env.*, **/.git, **/.venv, **/*.log; compose api builds from api/ context with explicit APP_ENV and CORS_ORIGIN.
public_evidence.proof: Rebuilt compose image ls -la /app shows zero .env files; docker run -e DATABASE_URL=OVERRIDE proves real environment beats .env.
public_evidence.ability: Docker build hygiene and environment separation.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Prevents the exact class of incident where development credentials ship to production in the image layer.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Implemented pydantic-settings schema with required no-default fields and validators.
Chose env-overrides (A) and platform env vars (A); fixed baked-.env bug.
Proved missing DATABASE_URL and invalid APP_ENV crash at startup naming the variable.
Verified docker -e overrides .env via pydantic-settings priority.

teaching_approaches.detail: Concrete required-vs-optional schema and failure-first drills
